column1: # THE BAPTISM OF JULIA JUANICO - found 13 September 2026, by searching her FATHER.
# San Francisco de Asis, Ciudad Vieja, Montevideo. Index ark 1:1:6D7Z-34VX;
# image ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-NLLP. Index-level; the image is not yet opened.
# The same parish where she married in 1864, where her son Candido Jaime was baptised in 1886,
# and where her daughter Maria married Jaime Herrera later that year. Four generations of this
# family pass through one church in the Ciudad Vieja.

column3: Her death registration of 1910 estimated 1844 from a stated age of 66. She was 67. An age at death is an estimate; a baptism is a date.

column2: 4 October 1843, San Francisco de Asis, Ciudad Vieja
column3: Baptised at ten and a half months - the same unhurried habit as her own son Candido Jaime, baptised at 21 months in 1886.

column2: *** Juliana JOAQUINA Gonzalez *** - the full name, not just "Juliana Gonzalez"
column3: A fifth record naming Julia's mother, and the first to give her middle name.
Presumably her father's brother - a new Juanico.
Presumably her mother's kinswoman - a new Gonzalez.
